# Surface Studio

> Surface Studio is a PU paint and polish studio in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It finishes kitchen shutters, wardrobes, doors, furniture and wall panels using wood coatings from Sirca, ICA and Axalta, in matte or glossy finishes.

- Business type: PU paint, PU polish and wood finishing studio
- Location: Bollaram Industrial Area (IDA Bollaram), Bollaram Village, Hyderabad, Telangana 502325, India (Plus Code G8XV+8C5; 17.5484382, 78.343641)

## Services
- PU Paint: solid-colour 2K polyurethane, matte or glossy, any RAL / NCS shade or matched sample (from ₹300/sq ft)
- PU Polish: clear or tinted PU on veneer and solid wood, matte or glossy, natural or coloured (from ₹210/sq ft)
- Metallic and pearl PU paint (Axalta) (from ₹400/sq ft)
- Modular panel finishing from factory cutlists (BSL = both sides, OSL = one side), barcode-tracked, delivered in batches
- Furniture and door refinishing in PU polish or paint
- Instant quote: upload an .xlsx or .csv cutlist at https://surfacestudio.co.in/#instant-quote for an estimate and quote code

## PU facts
- PU (polyurethane) is a two-component coating sprayed in thin layers that cures into a tough, smooth matte or glossy film
- PU paint is pigmented (solid colour); PU polish is clear, over wood or veneer
- Can be applied to MDF, HDHMR, solid wood, veneer, plywood, WPC, laminate (with adhesion primer), metal and glass
- PU painted shutter layers: board, sanding and edge sealing, PU sealer/primer, colour coats, finish coat
- PU polish layers: wood or veneer core, sanding, filling, two coats of PU sealer, clear topcoat
- Compared with Duco and melamine, PU is more durable, holds gloss longer and resists yellowing and cracking
- Care: microfibre cloth and mild soap; avoid abrasives, harsh chemicals and standing water

## Process
1. Surface preparation  2. Sealer and primer  3. Precision coating  4. Controlled curing  5. Final inspection and dispatch
